description: material point: anisotropic_damage_mazars/2d_uniaxial (uniaxial load/unload path, 20 steps)

build.cxx_flags: -ffp-contract=off -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -g3 -ggdb3 -flarge-source-files -std=c++20 -flto=auto -fno-fat-lto-objects -fPIC -frounding-math (actual flags of src/model/solid_mechanics/solid_mechanics_model.cc; warnings and non-FP -D defines omitted)

quantities.name: input/grad_u_prescribed
quantities.description: input: prescribed H_k (u = H_k X) for every requested step

quantities.name: grad_u
quantities.description: displacement gradient stored by the material after the step (computeAllStresses: FE gradient of u = H X; plastic_mazars stores (grad_u - eps_p) + eps_p)

quantities.name: stress
quantities.description: Cauchy/first-PK stress as stored by the material (getStress)

quantities.name: tangent
quantities.description: computeTangentModuli: d sigma_row / d epsilon_col in Akantu Voigt order (parameters.voigt_order; 1D xx, 2D xx yy xy, 3D xx yy zz yz xz xy; shear components act on engineering strains 2 eps_ij); stored [row, col] row-major

quantities.name: internal/elastic_stress
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

quantities.name: internal/equivalent_strain
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

quantities.name: internal/trace_damage
quantities.description: internal variable at the integration point after the step, raw Akantu component order (a dim x dim tensor is column-major: component r + c*dim is M(r, c))

notes: NaN (D-046 (4); checked by an independent review): tangent holds 57 default quiet NaNs (entries 0 and 4 at step index 8; entries 0, 1, 3, 4 and 8 from step index 9), stress 16 and energy/potential 4 (every entry from step index 16). They are legitimate upstream output (UD-031): each time a point reaches the broken state, the tension branch of material_anisotropic_damage_tmpl.hh:229-238 rewrites the material-wide E and nu so that kappa <- (1 - Dc) kappa at fixed lambda; repeated, this drives 3 kappa - lambda through 0 (measured by an independent review: mu < 0 at step indices 6-7, lambda = -inf and mu = +inf at step index 8, so lambda + 2 mu is NaN). This golden (aarch64) holds 0x7ff8000000000000; the x86_64 oracle writes 0xfff8000000000000 at exactly these positions. Uninitialised data: the tangent depends on upstream's uninitialised A_diag entries through that material-wide rewrite (it fires when tr D' > Dc, and D reads A_diag): three identical x86_64 oracle runs gave two variants (90 of 180 finite values differ from step index 2; stress, energy/potential and equivalent_strain identical across runs). The tangent of this case is therefore excluded from the bitwise replay (crates/akantu-solid/tests/material_fixtures_mat3.rs::anisotropic_damage_equivalent_strain_and_tangent_bitwise), like internal/damage, and is not an x86_64 golden (D-035); anisotropic_damage_material_points_match_oracle_where_defined still compares it by value with this recorded run. Follow-up: regeneration against a patched oracle with zero-initialised A_diag (D-003 A). Data files unchanged since the note was added.
